Core

Divider

Horizontal or vertical separator, optionally with a centred label. Class contract: .rse-divider.

Live example

The example needs JavaScript; the usage below shows the markup.

Usage

Thin rule for separating sections, form groups, or a vertical rule between toolbar items.

<Divider />
<Divider label="ou" />
<Divider orientation="vertical" />

Uses --rse-color-border-subtle only — never a heavier structuring device in this brand. orientation="vertical" needs a parent with an explicit height (e.g. a flex row) via alignSelf: stretch.

Plain HTML contract

<div class="rse-divider rse-divider--labelled" role="separator" aria-orientation="horizontal">
  <span class="rse-divider__line"></span>
  <span class="rse-divider__label">ou</span>
  <span class="rse-divider__line"></span>
</div>

A plain rule needs only .rse-divider. A vertical rule uses <span class="rse-divider rse-divider--vertical" role="separator" aria-orientation="vertical"></span> inside a flex row with a defined height. React forwards the ref and native attributes to the outer div (horizontal) or span (vertical), and merges className.

Props

PropTypeRequiredNotes
orientationhorizontal vertical—
labelstring—Optional centered label (horizontal only), e.g. "ou"

Also accepts every attribute of React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, a ref and className.

CSS classes

Blocks
.rse-divider
Elements
.rse-divider__label .rse-divider__line
Modifiers
.rse-divider--labelled .rse-divider--vertical
